## Checklist

- [ ] I edited **`data/papers.yml`** (and `data/taxonomy.yml` if I added a stage/objective/kind/category) — **not** `README.md` by hand.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/generate_readme.py` and committed the regenerated **`README.md`** in the same PR.
- [ ] Each new entry has a correct `stage` (one id), `objectives`, and `kind`.
- [ ] I added `code:` **only** when a public repo/artifact exists, and I checked the link opens (HTTP 200). Otherwise I used `paper:` / `project:`.
- [ ] `paper:` points to a stable page (arXiv abstract, DOI, or the USENIX/IEEE/NDSS page) — not a random mirror.
- [ ] The paper is in scope: security / privacy / safety of **physical or embodied AI** (AV, drone/UAV, robot, embodied LLM/VLA, or the CPS hardware layer).
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing entry.
